  "new_string": "## 3A. Control rails, LoRA stacking, and pre-processing — concrete recipes\n\nSection 3 lists these as gaps; this section pins the migration recipes. Every claim cites either a Wan2GP file (current behavior) or a VibeComfy file (target mechanism).\n\n### LoRA stacking and key sanitization\n\nThe Wan2GP path performs three LoRA-related transforms that must be reproduced under VibeComfy:\n\n1. **Key tolerance** — `apply_lora_key_tolerance_patch` at `reigh-worker/source/models/wgp/wgp_patches.py:384-483` monkeypatches `wgp.get_loras_preprocessor` to strip keys with no recognized LoRA suffix (e.g. `diff_m`, `norm_k_img` from `lightx2v/Wan2.2-Distill-Loras`) and keys whose module path doesn't exist in the transformer. ComfyUI's native loader silently skips unrecognized keys, so a portion of the WGP behavior is already inherent to the target — but the strict module-name check (`module_name not in modules_set` at `wgp_patches.py:466`) is not.\n2. **Qwen LoRA directory routing** — `apply_qwen_lora_directory_patch` at `wgp_patches.py:247-293` redirects `get_lora_dir(model_type)` to `loras_qwen/` for any Qwen model. ComfyUI uses a single `loras/` folder by convention.\n3. **Multiplier parser harmonization** — `apply_lora_multiplier_parser_patch` at `wgp_patches.py:326-348` swaps the WGP parser to the 3-phase parser shared with mmgp. This is a WGP-internal concern with no Comfy equivalent.\n\n**Target VibeComfy mechanism.** Under `vibecomfy/docs/authoring.md:50-54`, sanitization decorates handles (the `LoraLoader*` node still produces a `MODEL` handle) so it is a **patch**, not a new template. It belongs under `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/patches/lora_sanitize.py`. The patch contract:\n\n```text\napplies_to(wf): any node.class_type in {\"LoraLoader\", \"LoraLoaderModelOnly\", \"WanVideoLoraSelect\", \"WanVideoLoraSelectMulti\"}\napply(wf): wrap each matched node by injecting a sanitizing pre-load callback OR\n           replace the loader's class_type with a sanitizing variant registered as a custom node;\n           the chosen approach must keep the produced handle (`MODEL` slot 0 for LoraLoader*,\n           `WANVIDLORA` for WanVideoLoraSelect*) bit-identical so downstream edges survive.\n```\n\nThe pre-load callback approach is preferred because it keeps the graph topology unchanged and avoids a custom_node dependency. Implementation: ComfyUI exposes `comfy.utils.load_torch_file`; the patch monkeypatches it inside the embedded session (analogous to WGP's `get_loras_preprocessor` monkeypatch) to strip non-standard suffixes and unmatched module names before mmgp / `LoraLoader` sees them. The `LoraLoaderModelOnly` node ultimately calls `comfy.sd.load_lora_for_models`, so the strip happens at the same boundary as today.\n\n**Multiple LoRAs with weights.** Two patterns:\n\n- ComfyUI native chain — daisy-chain `LoraLoaderModelOnly` nodes, each consuming `model` from the previous one's output 0 and setting `lora_name` and `strength_model`. Already done in `ready_templates/video/ltx2_3_t2v.py:103-115` (two LTX distilled LoRAs in series).\n- WanVideoWrapper multi — `WanVideoLoraSelectMulti` (`vibecomfy/ready_templates/video/wanvideo_wrapper_22_s2v_context_window.py:60`, `wanvideo_wrapper_21_14b_t2v.py:89`, `wanvideo_wrapper_wan_animate.py:150`) accepts up to N LoRAs in a single node and feeds `WanVideoModelLoader.lora`. Adding LoRAs is a widget edit, not a topology change.\n\n**Qwen LoRA directory.** ComfyUI's `folder_paths.get_filename_list(\"loras\")` is the only directory of record. The migration ships a `loras_qwen/` symlink (or copies LoRAs) into the worker image's `models/loras/` so the Qwen Lightning LoRA at `Qwen-Image-Edit-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors` resolves. The directory-routing patch is **not** ported.\n\n**Worked example — Qwen image edit with stacked style LoRA.** Task: `qwen_image_style` runs through `edit/qwen_image_edit.py`. The template already loads the Lightning LoRA at `edit/qwen_image_edit.py:112-116`. To stack a user style LoRA on top, the registry applies a `stack_lora` patch:\n\n```text\n1. Find existing LoraLoaderModelOnly node id (call it L1) by class_type.\n2. Find the edge L1.0 → ModelSamplingAuraFlow.model (template line `edit/qwen_image_edit.py:132-135`).\n3. Insert L2 = LoraLoaderModelOnly(lora_name=<style>, strength_model=<w>); connect L1.0 → L2.model.\n4. wf.replace_edge(\"ModelSamplingAuraFlow.model\", \"L2.0\").\n5. Apply lora_sanitize patch (sanitizer is graph-wide so it picks up both L1 and L2).\n```\n\nThe sanitizer prevents L2 from raising on non-standard keys (the Wan2GP failure mode at `wgp_patches.py:443-468`). Output of the chain is an unchanged `MODEL` handle into `ModelSamplingAuraFlow`, so downstream nodes — `CFGNorm` at `edit/qwen_image_edit.py:136-138` and onward — need no edits. This is a pure decoration, eligible to be a patch under the rule at `vibecomfy/docs/authoring.md:54`.\n\n### Control rails: pre-process vs in-workflow\n\nThe current Wan2GP rails enter through `vendor_imports.py:91-113` (`FlowAnnotator`, `CannyVideoAnnotator`, `DepthV2VideoAnnotator`, `PoseBodyFaceVideoAnnotator`) and the Uni3C cache at `model_ops.py:234-260`. ControlNet templates exist in `ready_templates/` (`wanvideo_wrapper_22_5b_i2v_controlnet.py`, `wanvideo_wrapper_22_5b_t2v_controlnet.py`, `wanvideo_wrapper_21_14b_fun_control.py`, `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_control_lora.py`), and DepthAnythingV2 is already a node inside `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:171-173,388-391`. Per-rail decision:\n\n| Rail | Decision | Mechanism | Rationale |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Canny | Pre-process | reigh-worker calls `CannyVideoAnnotator` (kept in `source/media/structure/preprocessors.py` per Section 3) and writes a guide video; templates accept it via `VHS_LoadVideo`. | No `CannyEdge` node-pack dependency; reuses existing reigh-worker code; rail is a guide-video, not a graph splice. |\n| Depth | In-workflow when the chosen template already has it (e.g. `DepthAnything_V2` node in `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:388-391`); pre-process otherwise. | When in-workflow: feed `VHS_LoadVideo.0` into the existing `DepthAnything_V2.images` input. When pre-process: same as Canny. | Avoid double-running depth when the template owns it; avoid forcing a depth node into templates that don't have one. |\n| DWPose | Pre-process | reigh-worker calls `PoseBodyFaceVideoAnnotator`; output is a guide video. `ltx2_3_runexx_motion_transfer_dwpose.py` is the LTX-side reference for in-workflow DWPose if a future rail demands it. | DWPose model (`yolox_l.onnx` + `dw-ll_ucoco_384.onnx`) is heavy; one source of truth in reigh-worker is simpler than custom_node bring-up. |\n| Optical flow | Pre-process | reigh-worker calls `FlowAnnotator` + `flow_viz` (`vendor_imports.py:91-98`); writes flow-viz frames as a guide video. | Same rationale as DWPose; no widely-adopted Comfy flow node-pack. |\n| Uni3C | In-workflow patch with cache outside the IR | `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/patches/uni3c.py` (NEW) splices a Uni3C ControlNet apply-node into a Wan VACE/I2V template; the heavyweight ControlNet checkpoint load is wrapped in a session-scoped Python cache (module-level dict keyed on `EmbeddedSession.id` and ckpt path), populated once per worker process and cleared by the existing memory-cleanup hook at `source/task_handlers/queue/memory_cleanup.py:41-51`. | `VibeWorkflow` is graph metadata only — there's no IR slot for \"cached weights.\" The cache must live in the runtime layer (analogous to WGP's `orchestrator._cached_uni3c_controlnet` at `model_ops.py:225,246-269`). The patch is graph-topological per `controlnet.py:45-96`. |\n\n**Why the cache lives outside the IR.** `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:35-42` defines `RunResult` and the `EmbeddedSession` API; there is no public hook for \"preserve this loaded weight tensor across runs in the same session.\" VibeComfy already uses a session-warm pattern (`runtime_surface.md:64-105`) and the embedded HiddenSwitch context owns model lifecycle. The Uni3C migration plan: the Uni3C patch's `apply` records that Uni3C is required, and the reigh-worker adapter installs a `before_run` hook on the `EmbeddedSession` that calls `load_uni3c_controlnet(...)` (existing function via `vendor_imports.py:125-132`) once per session and stashes the result on a module-level dict. The Comfy node `WanVideoUni3CController` (or whatever the underlying custom node is named in `ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper`) reads from that dict via a small custom-node shim. **Open question Q13** below covers the custom-node shim ownership.\n\n**IR sketch — Wan I2V + Uni3C control rail.** Starting from `ready_templates/video/wanvideo_wrapper_21_14b_i2v.py` (already loads Wan I2V via `WanVideoModelLoader` at line 85), the Uni3C patch performs:\n\n```text\napplies_to(wf):\n    return any(n.class_type == \"WanVideoModelLoader\" for n in wf.nodes.values()) \\\n       and any(n.class_type == \"WanVideoSampler\" for n in wf.nodes.values())\n\napply(wf, *, guide_video_path, strength=1.0, ckpt_dir):\n    # 1. Locate sampler and its `image_embeds` source (the WanVideoVACEEncode or WanVideoImageToVideoEncode).\n    sampler_id = next(nid for nid, n in wf.nodes.items() if n.class_type == \"WanVideoSampler\")\n    embeds_edge = next(e for e in wf.edges\n                       if e.to_node == sampler_id and e.to_input == \"image_embeds\")\n    # 2. Add the guide-video loader and the Uni3C controller node (custom node from ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper).\n    guide = wf.add_node(\"VHS_LoadVideo\", widget_0=guide_video_path)\n    uni3c = wf.add_node(\"WanVideoUni3CController\",\n                        widget_0=ckpt_dir, widget_1=strength)\n    # 3. Splice: the existing embeds source still feeds the sampler, but the sampler's\n    #    `controlnet` (or `extra_model_inputs`) handle now consumes Uni3C output.\n    wf.connect(f\"{guide.id}.0\", f\"{uni3c.id}.images\")\n    wf.connect(f\"{uni3c.id}.0\", f\"{sampler_id}.controlnet\")\n    # 4. Mark cache requirement so the runtime adapter pre-loads the ckpt.\n    wf.metadata.setdefault(\"uni3c_ckpt_dir\", ckpt_dir)\n    return wf.finalize_metadata()\n```\n\nThe exact input slot name (`controlnet` vs `extra_model_inputs`) depends on the WanVideoSampler node schema in the installed `ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper` revision; that is a Sprint 4 schema check (`vibecomfy.cli inspect ready_templates/video/wanvideo_wrapper_21_14b_i2v` per `vibecomfy/docs/adding_templates_models.md:137-143`).\n\n### Travel continuity and travel_stitch\n\nWan2GP travel mechanics are anchored in three files:\n\n- `_handle_travel_segment_via_queue_impl` at `reigh-worker/source/task_handlers/tasks/task_registry.py:1298-1357` resolves segment context, generation inputs, image refs, and structure guidance, then submits a child `GenerationTask` via `task_queue.submit_task(...)` (`task_registry.py:1337-1344`) using the DB task id as the queue task id.\n- `_apply_video_source_continuation` at `task_registry.py:1106-1144` writes `video_source` (path of the predecessor segment's tail) into `generation_params` and removes `image_start`. This handles both SVI and `prefix_video_source` strategies.\n- `_apply_uni3c_config` at `task_registry.py:1326-1328` (called next) bolts on Uni3C parameters when `travel_guidance_config.kind in {\"vace\", \"uni3c\"}` (`travel/orchestrator.py:797`) or when structure guidance is `is_uni3c` (`travel/orchestrator.py:842-844`).\n\n**Pinned templates.**\n\n- Wan-family travel segment (`_derive_model_family(model_name) == \"wan\"` at `travel/orchestrator.py:38-49`): `ready_templates/video/wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py`. Its `WanVideoVACEStartToEndFrame` node at `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:470-475,498-504` is the seed-frame seam; `start_image` and `end_image` SetNodes at `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:236-279` are where the per-segment first/last frames bind.\n- LTX-family travel segment: `ready_templates/video/ltx2_3_runexx_first_last_frame.py`. Its widgetised first/last frame inputs are the direct LTX equivalent.\n\n**continue_video_path / video_source flow.** When `_apply_video_source_continuation` writes `generation_params[\"video_source\"] = <path>` (`task_registry.py:1119-1120`), the VibeComfy adapter translates that to a template patch:\n\n```text\nOn the chosen Wan VACE template:\n  1. Locate the VHS_LoadVideo node id that currently feeds `vhs_loadvideo_2` →\n     ImageResizeKJv2 → SetNode(\"InputVideo\") chain (wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:204-209).\n  2. Set node.widgets[\"video\"] = video_source_path (the predecessor's tail).\n  3. wf.finalize_metadata() so `register_input(\"video_source\", ...)` is emitted.\nOn the LTX runexx_first_last_frame template:\n  1. Set the LoadImage node for `start_image` to the predecessor's last extracted frame\n     (reigh-worker already extracts via `_resolve_image_references` at task_registry.py:1317).\n  2. Set the LoadImage for `end_image` to the next segment's target frame.\n```\n\n**SVI vs prefix continuation.** Both strategies share the `video_source` field in WGP (`task_registry.py:1141-1147`). In VibeComfy, both translate to the same `VHS_LoadVideo.video` widget edit; the SVI-specific latent-tail upload at `task_registry.py:1356` (`_upload_svi_latent_tail_if_available`) stays in reigh-worker and is unaffected by backend choice.\n\n**travel_stitch.** This is **NATIVE (no template)** in 1A — `source/task_handlers/travel/stitch.py:804` does ffmpeg-based concatenation with optional VLM enhancement. Backend selection is irrelevant. The only Comfy-side concern is that segment outputs come from `RunResult.outputs[0]` and match the path shape that stitch expects (`current_stitched_video_path` at `stitch.py:804`); the observability shim in Section 7 already normalizes `RunResult.outputs` to existing output-path shapes.\n\n### Qwen prompt expander placement\n\nDecision: **pre-process before workflow build** in reigh-worker. Rationale:\n\n- The expander rewrites prompt text and changes nothing about graph topology, so by the rule at `vibecomfy/docs/authoring.md:54` it is not a template / patch concern.\n- The current call site is `vendor_imports.py:32-45` returning Wan2GP's `prompt_enhancer` module. The migration ports the relevant function bodies (or installs the underlying HF model directly) into `reigh-worker/source/media/vlm/` next to the existing VLM service at `source/media/vlm/service.py`.\n- The expanded prompt is then written into the relevant `CLIPTextEncode` / `TextEncodeQwenImageEdit` / `WanVideoTextEncode` widget by the registry's parameter-wiring step, identical to how a user-supplied prompt is wired today.\n- Sprint 5 cohort B (Qwen) gates on the pre-processed prompt being byte-equivalent to WGP's expander output for a fixed corpus; this is a reigh-worker-only test, no VibeComfy code change.\n\nThis decision aligns with Section 3's \"Vendor-Utility Shims\" table, which already routes Qwen prompt expansion to reigh-worker pre-processing; Section 3A pins it as the canonical answer.\n\n## 4. Sprint-by-sprint migration plan"
}

1	# Migration Plan: reigh-worker Execution Backend from Wan2GP to VibeComfy
2	
3	> **Draft status:** Draft for migration planning, authored 2026-05-05.
4	
5	This document plans the migration of `reigh-worker` from its current in-process Wan2GP execution backend to VibeComfy while preserving the worker's external queue contracts, output shapes, per-task latency expectations, and non-negotiable memory-profile guarantees. The repos involved live side-by-side under the workspace: `reigh-worker/` is the current Wan2GP consumer, `vibecomfy/` is the target ComfyUI workflow runtime, and `reigh-worker-orchestrator/` provisions GPU worker images and startup commands.
6

8	
9	1. [Audit reigh-worker to Wan2GP integration](#1-audit-reigh-worker-to-wan2gp-integration)
10	1A. [Task-type to VibeComfy template triage](#1a-ta[REDACTED_SK])
11	2. [Audit VibeComfy capabilities](#2-audit-vibecomfy-capabilities)

22	## Goals
23	
24	- Preserve the Supabase queue contract observed by `reigh-worker` task claim, dispatch, status update, and completion paths.
25	- Preserve output shapes for every runtime task type, including image, video, edit, orchestration, raw-Comfy, and interpolation tasks.
26	- Preserve per-task latency SLOs or document measured exceptions before canary promotion.
27	- Preserve full memory-profile behavior, including low-VRAM, medium/default, high-VRAM, profiled, and per-task override semantics.
28	- Coordinate worker image and runtime changes with `reigh-worker-orchestrator` so provisioning, startup, health checks, and rollback all understand the selected backend.
29	- Retire Wan2GP only after shadow, dual-run comparison, cohort canaries, and closure sweeps demonstrate parity.
30	
31	## Non-Goals
32	
33	- No Supabase queue schema rework.
34	- No orchestrator scheduling or scaling algorithm changes beyond worker image/runtime selection and backend flag propagation.
35	- No `reigh-app` UI or API contract changes.
36	- No broad task-type redesign beyond the adapter and template-routing work required to preserve existing behavior.
37	- No deletion of Wan2GP surfaces before the Sprint 8 removal gate.
38	
39	## Settled Decisions
40	
41	- **SD-001** — Preserve current queue contracts and output shapes. _load_bearing: true_
42	  Rationale: `reigh-app`, orchestration handlers, and downstream completion logic depend on the existing worker-facing task contract.
43	- **SD-002** — Treat memory-profile parity as a pre-cutover gate. _load_bearing: true_
44	  Rationale: production currently relies on Wan2GP profile behavior for GPU fit, OOM avoidance, and latency/cost predictability.
45	- **SD-003** — Keep `reigh-worker/`, `reigh-worker-orchestrator/`, and `vibecomfy/` as independent repo workstreams. _load_bearing: true_
46	  Rationale: the workspace contains nested independent Git repos, so implementation, review, and closure sweeps must be scoped per repo.
47	- **SD-004** — Refactor the existing `source/models/comfy/` path into the VibeComfy adapter instead of running a second raw-Comfy implementation. _load_bearing: true_
48	  Rationale: keeping `comfy_handler.py` and `comfy_utils.py` as a parallel subprocess/client stack would leave two Comfy runtimes, two output contracts, and two telemetry paths to support during cutover.
49	- **SD-005** — Treat dynamic Wan2GP model definitions as build-time frozen VibeComfy template inputs unless Q1 decides otherwise. _load_bearing: true_
50	  Rationale: runtime-mutable JSON model definitions are a WGP-specific flexibility point; freezing them into reviewed templates and patches lowers cutover risk and makes validation reproducible.
51	- **SD-006** — Keep WGP and VibeComfy coinstalled in the worker image until the Sprint 8 removal gate. _load_bearing: true_
52	  Rationale: production rollback depends on switching process-level and task-type-level backend selection without rebuilding the worker image during canary.

91	### Repository Layout For Closure Sweeps
92	
93	`reigh-worker/`, `reigh-worker-orchestrator/`, and `vibecomfy/` are independent Git repos nested in the workspace. Any Git-aware closure sweep must run per repo, for example with `git -C reigh-worker grep ...` and `git -C reigh-worker-orchestrator grep ...`; a workspace-root `git grep` does not traverse those nested repo histories and can return zero hits for committed files that still exist inside the nested repos.
94	
95	## 1. Audit reigh-worker to Wan2GP integration
96	
97	### Runtime Entry Path
98	
99	`reigh-worker` enters Wan2GP through the worker server process, not through a separate backend service. `source/runtime/worker/server.py:232-243` defines the current WGP CLI surface:
100	
101	- `--wgp-attention-mode`
102	- `--wgp-compile`
103	- `--wgp-profile`
104	- `--wgp-vae-config`
105	- `--wgp-boost`
106	- `--wgp-transformer-quantization`
107	- `--wgp-transformer-dtype-policy`
108	- `--wgp-text-encoder-quantization`
109	- `--wgp-vae-precision`
110	- `--wgp-mixed-precision`
111	- `--wgp-preload-policy`
112	- `--wgp-preload`
113	
114	Startup then changes into the Wan2GP checkout, inserts it onto `sys.path`, imports `wgp` at `source/runtime/worker/server.py:551`, mutates WGP globals from the CLI flags at `server.py:554-568`, and creates `HeadlessTaskQueue` at `server.py:583-592`. That queue delegates model switching and generation to `WanOrchestrator` through `source/task_handlers/queue/task_queue.py:367-373` and `source/models/wgp/orchestrator.py`.
115	
116	There are also standalone legacy entrypoints. `reigh-worker/pyproject.toml:109` registers `headless_wgp = source.runtime.entrypoints.headless_wgp:WanOrchestrator`, and `pyproject.toml:165` repeats that registration under `[tool.headless_wan2gp.entrypoints]`. Root scripts `reigh-worker/headless_wgp.py` and `reigh-worker/headless_model_management.py` are wrapped by `source/runtime/entrypoints/headless_wgp.py` and `source/runtime/entrypoints/headless_model_management.py`.
117	
118	### Memory-Profile System
119	
120	Wan2GP profile behavior is externally visible and must be preserved. `source/runtime/worker/server.py:605-609` maps profile values to display labels:
121	
122	| Profile | Display label | Current role |
123	| --- | --- | --- |
124	| `1` | Max Performance | Production default and highest-throughput baseline. |
125	| `2` | High RAM | High-memory mode between max-performance and balanced. |
126	| `3` | Balanced | Development default and local/live-test baseline. |
127	| `4` | Conservative | Lower VRAM pressure. |
128	| `5` | Minimum | Most constrained VRAM mode. |
129	
130	When `--wgp-profile` is present, `source/runtime/worker/server.py:556-558` sets both `wgp_mod.force_profile_no` and `wgp_mod.default_profile`. Per-task WGP payloads also carry `override_profile`: passthrough mode defaults it to `-1` at `source/models/wgp/generators/wgp_params.py:166`, normal mode reads it from resolved params at `wgp_params.py:237`, and the final WGP parameter dict writes it at `wgp_params.py:374`.

139	| Live-test smoke harness | `--wgp-profile` default `3` | `reigh-worker/scripts/live_test/smoke.py:27` |

184	### Queue and Dispatch Shape
185	
186	There are two adapter seams to preserve:
187	
188	```text
189	Supabase task row
190	  -> source/runtime/worker/server.py process_single_task
191	  -> TaskRegistry.dispatch(task_type, context)
192	     -> Seam A: direct queue task
193	        _handle_direct_queue_task
194	          -> db_task_to_generation_task(...)
195	          -> HeadlessTaskQueue.submit_task(...)
196	          -> queue status polling
197	     -> Seam B: specialized handler with context["task_queue"]
198	        travel_segment / join_clips_segment / inpaint_frames / rife_interpolate_images
199	          -> handler-specific media prep
200	          -> child GenerationTask
201	          -> HeadlessTaskQueue.submit_task(...)
202	          -> handler-specific post-processing
203	```
204	
205	The direct seam is explicit at `source/task_handlers/tasks/task_registry.py:1436-1438` and `1544-1562`. The nested-handler seam is visible in the dispatch context parameters at `task_registry.py:1453`, `1462`, `1487`, `1496`, and `1505`, and in `travel_segment` queue submission at `task_registry.py:1331-1344`. Any VibeComfy adapter that only replaces `_handle_direct_queue_task` will miss child generation inside orchestrated handlers.
206	
207	Queue wait semantics are also shared in `source/task_handlers/queue/status_wait.py:17-38`, which polls `task_queue.get_task_status` until `completed`, `failed`, `missing`, or `timeout`. `source/runtime/worker/server.py:689-738` preserves the worker-facing result contract: handlers return `(success, output_location)` or `TaskResult`, non-orchestrator success becomes `Complete` with an output path, and orchestrators may remain `In Progress` while children run.
208	
209	### Model Load, Unload, and Runtime Mutation Lifecycle
210	
211	Wan2GP model state is mutable process-global state. `source/models/wgp/model_ops.py:65-193` implements `load_model_impl`: it resolves missing model definitions, checks WGP's current `transformer_type`/`reload_needed`, releases the current offload object, clears `wan_model`/`offloadobj`, runs Python and CUDA cleanup, calls `wgp.load_models(model_key)`, and writes the new loaded state back through `source/runtime/wgp_ports/runtime_registry.py:151-160`.
212	
213	`source/models/wgp/model_ops.py:196-231` implements `unload_model_impl` through WGP's `unload_model_if_needed`, then clears queue/orchestrator tracking and Uni3C cache. `load_missing_model_definition` at `model_ops.py:29-63` dynamically reads JSON model definitions from `Wan2GP/defaults/*.json`; the same repo also carries `Wan2GP/profiles/*`, so migration has to decide whether VibeComfy freezes model routing at build time or keeps a dynamic-model-definition path.
214	
215	Runtime mutation is isolated through `source/runtime/wgp_ports/runtime_registry.py`, including read-only vs mutable WGP module access, `set_wgp_model_def`, `set_wgp_reload_needed`, loaded model state setters, and runtime model patch transactions at `runtime_registry.py:201-220`. Queue-level model patch helpers also exist in `source/task_handlers/queue/model_patch_session.py:6-19` for snapshot/apply/restore flows. LoRA behavior spans `source/models/wgp/lora_setup.py` and patches in `source/models/wgp/wgp_patches.py`, especially the LoRA-key tolerance patch at `wgp_patches.py:384-483`, Qwen LoRA directory/parser/inpainting patches, and LoRA caching.
216

236	### Existing ComfyUI Integration in reigh-worker
237	
238	`source/models/comfy/comfy_handler.py` already handles the `comfy` task type, but it is a separate raw-Comfy path rather than a VibeComfy adapter. It imports `ComfyUIManager`, `ComfyUIClient`, `COMFY_PATH`, and `COMFY_PORT` from `source/models/comfy/comfy_utils.py:15`; lazy-starts a `python main.py --listen 0.0.0.0 --port ...` subprocess through `ComfyUIManager` at `comfy_utils.py:25-60`; submits raw workflow JSON to `/prompt` through `ComfyUIClient` at `comfy_utils.py:126-142`; polls `/history/{prompt_id}` and downloads outputs at `comfy_utils.py:144-199`; then writes the first output under `main_output_dir_base / "comfy"` at `comfy_handler.py:164-175`.
239	
240	The dispatch branch is `source/task_handlers/tasks/task_registry.py:1507-1510`. Dependent tests include `reigh-worker/tests/test_additional_coverage_modules.py:205-219` and coverage imports in `tests/test_wan2gp_direct_coverage_contracts.py:412-413,960-961`. Section 3 must make this explicit: refactor `comfy_handler.py` to delegate to VibeComfy runtime, retire `comfy_utils.py`, and migrate test imports.
241	
242	### Error Paths and Telemetry
243	
244	WGP errors are not always raised as Python exceptions, so `source/models/wgp/error_extraction.py:13-90` scans captured stdout/stderr for OOM, CUDA, model-loading, and generic Python error patterns. Worker failure handling then classifies retryable errors in `source/runtime/worker/server.py:740-757` and requeues or fails tasks.
245	
246	Logging suppresses known noisy substrings and third-party loggers, including `mmgp`, in `source/core/log/core.py:57-64` and `core.py:108-113`. The queue performs post-task memory cleanup without unloading models via `source/task_handlers/queue/memory_cleanup.py:16-75`, exposed through `HeadlessTaskQueue._cleanup_memory_after_task` at `task_queue.py:343-345`; that cleanup also clears unused Uni3C cache before CUDA/Python garbage collection at `memory_cleanup.py:41-51`. WGP output telemetry includes `source/models/wgp/generators/output.py:182-208`, which logs RAM and CUDA allocated/reserved/total VRAM. The migration needs Comfy/VibeComfy equivalents for these memory stats, task log anchoring, retry classification, and debug-card breadcrumbs.
247	
248	### Worker-Orchestrator Coupling
249	
250	`reigh-worker-orchestrator` has hardcoded Wan2GP startup assumptions:
251	
252	| Coupling | Source | Migration implication |
253	| --- | --- | --- |
254	| Legacy worker directory fallback `Headless-Wan2GP` | `gpu_orchestrator/runpod/worker_startup.template.sh:174` and fallback branch at `179-183` | Remove or rename fallback during final Wan2GP cleanup. |
255	| Wan2GP submodule reconciliation | `worker_startup.template.sh:267-292` | Remove stale `Wan2GP/` cleanup and missing-submodule hard fail once VibeComfy is canonical. |
256	| Production profile default | `worker_startup.template.sh:463` | Replace `--wgp-profile 1` with VibeComfy profile selection only after profile parity exists. |
257	| Pod disk sizing | `gpu_orchestrator/worker_spawner.py:279-281` and `391-395` | Current 50 GB disk/container defaults were sized around one Wan2GP family; dual-run may need a larger Sprint 0 baseline. |
258	| Worker image Dockerfile | `gpu_orchestrator/Dockerfile` | Verify and remove any Wan2GP install steps if present; current main may be generic and need no edit. |
259	| `mmgp` runtime dependency | `reigh-worker/pyproject.toml:13` | `mmgp==3.7.6` is WGP-specific and must be removed only after the WGP surface is retired. |
260	
261	## 1A. Task-type to VibeComfy template triage
262	
263	Section 1 enumerates the runtime task surface; Section 2 inventories the 50 ready templates under `vibecomfy/ready_templates/`. This section closes the gap between them by classifying every runtime task type (`source/task_handlers/tasks/task_types.py:120-138` ∪ `source/task_handlers/tasks/task_registry.py:1442-1511`) into one of three dispositions:
264	
265	- **NATIVE** — a `ready_templates/**` template is the direct execution unit; only parameter wiring (prompt, image inputs, seed, resolution, profile overlay) is required.
266	- **ADAPT** — an existing template is the closest basis but needs concrete graph edits or patches (added/removed nodes, swapped LoRA loaders, control rails spliced in via `replace_edge`, output shape coercion).
267	- **NEW** — no usable basis exists in `ready_templates/`; a new ready template must be authored against a named ComfyUI workflow / model family before the cohort can canary.
268	
269	The `concrete edits required` column lists graph-level deltas only, not parameter wiring. Section 3A pins the recipes for the LoRA, control-rail, travel-continuity, and prompt-expander edits that recur across rows.
270

313	
314	## 2. Audit VibeComfy capabilities
315	
316	### VibeWorkflow IR and Authoring Model
317	
318	VibeComfy's canonical editable representation is `VibeWorkflow`, not raw Comfy API JSON. `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/workflow.py:76-85` defines the workflow IR with nodes, edges, inputs, outputs, requirements, and metadata. The migration-relevant mutators are:
319	
320	- `finalize_metadata()` at `workflow.py:99-110`, which rebuilds inputs, outputs, and requirements.
321	- `add_node()` at `workflow.py:130-134`.
322	- `connect()` at `workflow.py:145-151`.
323	- `disconnect()` at `workflow.py:153-163`.
324	- `replace_edge()` at `workflow.py:165-172`.
325	- `validate()` at `workflow.py:174-193`.
326	- `compile("api")` at `workflow.py:195-207`, which produces the dict accepted by ComfyUI `/prompt`.
327	
328	`vibecomfy/docs/authoring.md:5` states that `VibeWorkflow` is the only editable IR and that API JSON is an escape hatch. The template/patch rule is load-bearing for the migration: `docs/authoring.md:23` says to use blocks/templates when the call changes handles, `docs/authoring.md:50-54` says to use patches for decoration/adjustment, and the rule is repeated as `changes-handles -> new template; decorates-handles -> patch`.
329	
330	### Ready Templates
331	
332	The live filesystem count is 50 Python ready templates:
333

335	find vibecomfy/ready_templates -type f -name '*.py' | wc -l
336	=> 50
337	```
338

344	| `ready_templates/edit/` | `qwen_image_edit.py`, Flux Klein image edit templates | Qwen/Flux image edit task families. |
345	| `ready_templates/video/` | `wan_t2v.py`, `wan_i2v.py`, `ltx2_3_t2v.py`, `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py`, WanVideoWrapper 2.1/2.2 variants | Wan, LTX, VACE, i2v/t2v direct queue tasks and later orchestrated child tasks. |

361	
362	### Runtime Execution Surface
363	
364	VibeComfy exposes both one-shot and warm-session execution:
365	
366	| Path | Source | Behavior |
367	| --- | --- | --- |
368	| Embedded one-shot | `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/run.py:75-84` | `run_embedded` / `run_embedded_sync` create an `EmbeddedSession` from workflow metadata, run it, then stop it. |
369	| External or managed server one-shot | `runtime/run.py:27-72` | `run` / `run_sync` use `comfy_server`, schema gate with `/object_info`, queue `/prompt`, and return a `RunResult`. |
370	| Warm embedded session | `vibecomfy/docs/runtime_surface.md:64-105`; `runtime/session.py` | Holds a HiddenSwitch `Comfy()` context across runs and supports `start`, `run`, `flush`, `reconfigure`, `stop`. This is the closest analogue to vendored in-process `wgp.py` for `reigh-worker`. |
371	| Warm managed server | `runtime/server.py:10-34`; `runtime/session.py` | Starts or reuses `comfyui serve`, uses HTTP readiness and prompt queueing. |
372	| HTTP client | `runtime/client.py:8-40` | Uses `/system_stats`, `/prompt`, `/api/free`, and `/object_info`. |
373	
374	`RunResult` is defined at `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:35-42` and carries `run_id`, `prompt_id`, `outputs`, `metadata_path`, and `log_path`. `vibecomfy/docs/runtime_surface.md:25-38` documents the HTTP surface currently used, and `runtime_surface.md:40-53` documents the embedded HiddenSwitch surface.
375	
376	### Existing Memory Controls
377	
378	VibeComfy has lower-level memory/session knobs, but not Wan2GP's five-tier profile abstraction. `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:45-53` defines `SessionConfig` fields:
379	
380	- `vram_policy`
381	- `reserve_vram_gb`
382	- `cache_policy`
383	- `disable_smart_memory`
384	- `warm_policy`
385	- `auto_flush_vram_threshold_gb`
386	- `port`
387	- `extra`
388	
389	There are two translation paths, and the citations are intentionally distinct:
390	
391	| Translation path | Source | What it builds |
392	| --- | --- | --- |
393	| Embedded ComfyUI `Configuration` | `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:625-656` | `_embedded_configuration_for_session` maps `vram_policy` to `highvram`/`lowvram`/`normalvram`, maps `reserve_vram_gb` to `reserve_vram`, maps `cache_policy` to `cache_classic`/`cache_none`/`cache_lru`, applies `disable_smart_memory`, then merges `config.extra` and `VIBECOMFY_COMFY_CONFIGURATION` JSON. |
394	| Managed server CLI argv | `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:663-678` | `_comfy_server_argv` maps the same `SessionConfig` to `--highvram`/`--lowvram`/`--normalvram`, `--reserve-vram`, `--disable-smart-memory`, `--cache-classic`/`--cache-none`/`--cache-lru N`, and `--port`. |
395	
396	The migration gap is not "no memory controls"; the gap is "no Wan2GP-compatible 1-5 profile tier overlay that maps task/global `override_profile` semantics onto these existing knobs."
397	
398	### Validation Surface
399	
400	Validation exists at both IR and schema levels:
401	
402	- `VibeWorkflow.validate()` is in `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/workflow.py:174-193`.
403	- Schema validation and API link-shape validation are in `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/schema/validate.py:15-174`.
404	- Runtime/local schema providers and object-info caching are in `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/schema/provider.py:76-158` and `schema/cache.py:11-50`.

410	### RunPod Execution Path
411	
412	VibeComfy delegates RunPod operations to `runpod-lifecycle`. Optional extras in `vibecomfy/pyproject.toml:23-29` include `runpod-lifecycle`, and `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/commands/runpod.py:20-43` imports it from the installed package or a local checkout. The command surface includes list, status, terminate, gpu-types, and corpus-matrix at `commands/runpod.py:46-104`.
413	
414	For `reigh-worker`, the near-term target should still be `EmbeddedSession`, not the VibeComfy RunPod CLI. The orchestrator already provisions GPU workers; VibeComfy's RunPod path is useful for template corpus validation and smoke tests, while `EmbeddedSession` is the analogue of the current vendored `wgp.py` execution object.

453	### Memory-Profile Abstraction (P0)
454	
455	VibeComfy should not clone Wan2GP internals. It should add a thin compatibility overlay on the existing `SessionConfig` controls in `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:45-53`.
456	
457	Required module:
458	
459	```text
460	vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/profile.py
461	```
462	
463	Required API:
464	
465	```python
466	class MemoryProfile(Enum):
467	    MAX_PERFORMANCE = 1
468	    HIGH_RAM = 2
469	    BALANCED = 3
470	    CONSERVATIVE = 4
471	    MINIMUM = 5
472	
473	    def to_session_overrides(self) -> dict[str, object]:
474	        ...
475	```
476	
477	`to_session_overrides()` returns a partial dict overlay for `SessionConfig` fields only: `vram_policy`, `reserve_vram_gb`, `cache_policy`, and `disable_smart_memory`. The resulting `SessionConfig` must flow through the existing VibeComfy translation paths unchanged: `_embedded_configuration_for_session` at `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:625-656` for embedded ComfyUI `Configuration`, and `_comfy_server_argv` at `session.py:663-678` for managed-server CLI argv.
478	
479	Starting Sprint 1 mapping:
480	
481	| Wan2GP profile | `MemoryProfile` | `SessionConfig` override |
482	| --- | --- | --- |
483	| `1` | `MAX_PERFORMANCE` | `{"vram_policy": "high", "cache_policy": "smart"}` |
484	| `2` | `HIGH_RAM` | `{"vram_policy": "high", "cache_policy": "lru:32"}` |
485	| `3` | `BALANCED` | `{"vram_policy": "normal", "cache_policy": "smart"}` |
486	| `4` | `CONSERVATIVE` | `{"vram_policy": "low", "cache_policy": "classic", "reserve_vram_gb": 2.0}` |
487	| `5` | `MINIMUM` | `{"vram_policy": "low", "cache_policy": "none", "disable_smart_memory": True, "reserve_vram_gb": 4.0}` |
488	
489	`reigh-worker` must mirror WGP `override_profile` semantics: the process default profile is used when no task override is present, and a per-call `override_profile` replaces the default for that single VibeComfy run. The adapter should resolve `override_profile` before workflow execution, not mutate process-global defaults.

545	### Dynamic Model Definitions and Model Lifecycle
546	
547	Recommendation for Open Question Q1: freeze dynamic Wan2GP model definitions into VibeComfy templates and patches at build time. Wan2GP can load JSON model definitions from `Wan2GP/defaults/*` and `Wan2GP/profiles/*` through `load_missing_model_definition`, but carrying that dynamism into VibeComfy would weaken template validation and make rollback comparisons harder to reproduce.
548	
549	The cutover design should use a long-lived VibeComfy `EmbeddedSession` as the analogue of the current in-process WGP backend. Model management work before cutover:
550	
551	- Define which template/model packages are present in the worker image at build time.
552	- Define when `EmbeddedSession.reconfigure()` is allowed for profile changes, and when the worker must restart instead.
553	- Preserve queue-visible load/unload behavior even if the implementation becomes "select template and warm session" rather than WGP's `load_model_impl` / `unload_model_impl`.
554	- Keep `headless_model_management` behavior under review until Q11 decides whether any non-WGP callers require migration rather than deletion.

580	## 3A. Control rails, LoRA stacking, and pre-processing — concrete recipes
581	
582	Section 3 lists these as gaps; this section pins the migration recipes. Every claim cites either a Wan2GP file (current behavior) or a VibeComfy file (target mechanism).
583	
584	### LoRA stacking and key sanitization
585	
586	The Wan2GP path performs three LoRA-related transforms that must be reproduced under VibeComfy:
587	
588	1. **Key tolerance** — `apply_lora_key_tolerance_patch` at `reigh-worker/source/models/wgp/wgp_patches.py:384-483` monkeypatches `wgp.get_loras_preprocessor` to strip keys with no recognized LoRA suffix (e.g. `diff_m`, `norm_k_img` from `lightx2v/Wan2.2-Distill-Loras`) and keys whose module path doesn't exist in the transformer. ComfyUI's native loader silently skips unrecognized keys, so a portion of the WGP behavior is already inherent to the target — but the strict module-name check (`module_name not in modules_set` at `wgp_patches.py:466`) is not.
589	2. **Qwen LoRA directory routing** — `apply_qwen_lora_directory_patch` at `wgp_patches.py:247-293` redirects `get_lora_dir(model_type)` to `loras_qwen/` for any Qwen model. ComfyUI uses a single `loras/` folder by convention.
590	3. **Multiplier parser harmonization** — `apply_lora_multiplier_parser_patch` at `wgp_patches.py:326-348` swaps the WGP parser to the 3-phase parser shared with mmgp. This is a WGP-internal concern with no Comfy equivalent.
591	
592	**Target VibeComfy mechanism.** Under `vibecomfy/docs/authoring.md:50-54`, sanitization decorates handles (the `LoraLoader*` node still produces a `MODEL` handle) so it is a **patch**, not a new template. It belongs under `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/patches/lora_sanitize.py`. The patch contract:
593	
594	```text
595	applies_to(wf): any node.class_type in {"LoraLoader", "LoraLoaderModelOnly", "WanVideoLoraSelect", "WanVideoLoraSelectMulti"}
596	apply(wf): wrap each matched node by injecting a sanitizing pre-load callback OR
597	           replace the loader's class_type with a sanitizing variant registered as a custom node;
598	           the chosen approach must keep the produced handle (`MODEL` slot 0 for LoraLoader*,
599	           `WANVIDLORA` for WanVideoLoraSelect*) bit-identical so downstream edges survive.
600	```
601	
602	The pre-load callback approach is preferred because it keeps the graph topology unchanged and avoids a custom_node dependency. Implementation: ComfyUI exposes `comfy.utils.load_torch_file`; the patch monkeypatches it inside the embedded session (analogous to WGP's `get_loras_preprocessor` monkeypatch) to strip non-standard suffixes and unmatched module names before mmgp / `LoraLoader` sees them. The `LoraLoaderModelOnly` node ultimately calls `comfy.sd.load_lora_for_models`, so the strip happens at the same boundary as today.
603	
604	**Multiple LoRAs with weights.** Two patterns:
605	
606	- ComfyUI native chain — daisy-chain `LoraLoaderModelOnly` nodes, each consuming `model` from the previous one's output 0 and setting `lora_name` and `strength_model`. Already done in `ready_templates/video/ltx2_3_t2v.py:103-115` (two LTX distilled LoRAs in series).
607	- WanVideoWrapper multi — `WanVideoLoraSelectMulti` (`vibecomfy/ready_templates/video/wanvideo_wrapper_22_s2v_context_window.py:60`, `wanvideo_wrapper_21_14b_t2v.py:89`, `wanvideo_wrapper_wan_animate.py:150`) accepts up to N LoRAs in a single node and feeds `WanVideoModelLoader.lora`. Adding LoRAs is a widget edit, not a topology change.
608	
609	**Qwen LoRA directory.** ComfyUI's `folder_paths.get_filename_list("loras")` is the only directory of record. The migration ships a `loras_qwen/` symlink (or copies LoRAs) into the worker image's `models/loras/` so the Qwen Lightning LoRA at `Qwen-Image-Edit-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors` resolves. The directory-routing patch is **not** ported.
610	
611	**Worked example — Qwen image edit with stacked style LoRA.** Task: `qwen_image_style` runs through `edit/qwen_image_edit.py`. The template already loads the Lightning LoRA at `edit/qwen_image_edit.py:112-116`. To stack a user style LoRA on top, the registry applies a `stack_lora` patch:
612	
613	```text
614	1. Find existing LoraLoaderModelOnly node id (call it L1) by class_type.
615	2. Find the edge L1.0 → ModelSamplingAuraFlow.model (template line `edit/qwen_image_edit.py:132-135`).
616	3. Insert L2 = LoraLoaderModelOnly(lora_name=<style>, strength_model=<w>); connect L1.0 → L2.model.
617	4. wf.replace_edge("ModelSamplingAuraFlow.model", "L2.0").
618	5. Apply lora_sanitize patch (sanitizer is graph-wide so it picks up both L1 and L2).
619	```
620	
621	The sanitizer prevents L2 from raising on non-standard keys (the Wan2GP failure mode at `wgp_patches.py:443-468`). Output of the chain is an unchanged `MODEL` handle into `ModelSamplingAuraFlow`, so downstream nodes — `CFGNorm` at `edit/qwen_image_edit.py:136-138` and onward — need no edits. This is a pure decoration, eligible to be a patch under the rule at `vibecomfy/docs/authoring.md:54`.
622	
623	### Control rails: pre-process vs in-workflow
624	
625	The current Wan2GP rails enter through `vendor_imports.py:91-113` (`FlowAnnotator`, `CannyVideoAnnotator`, `DepthV2VideoAnnotator`, `PoseBodyFaceVideoAnnotator`) and the Uni3C cache at `model_ops.py:234-260`. ControlNet templates exist in `ready_templates/` (`wanvideo_wrapper_22_5b_i2v_controlnet.py`, `wanvideo_wrapper_22_5b_t2v_controlnet.py`, `wanvideo_wrapper_21_14b_fun_control.py`, `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_control_lora.py`), and DepthAnythingV2 is already a node inside `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:171-173,388-391`. Per-rail decision:
626	
627	| Rail | Decision | Mechanism | Rationale |
628	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
629	| Canny | Pre-process | reigh-worker calls `CannyVideoAnnotator` (kept in `source/media/structure/preprocessors.py` per Section 3) and writes a guide video; templates accept it via `VHS_LoadVideo`. | No `CannyEdge` node-pack dependency; reuses existing reigh-worker code; rail is a guide-video, not a graph splice. |
630	| Depth | In-workflow when the chosen template already has it (e.g. `DepthAnything_V2` node in `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:388-391`); pre-process otherwise. | When in-workflow: feed `VHS_LoadVideo.0` into the existing `DepthAnything_V2.images` input. When pre-process: same as Canny. | Avoid double-running depth when the template owns it; avoid forcing a depth node into templates that don't have one. |
631	| DWPose | Pre-process | reigh-worker calls `PoseBodyFaceVideoAnnotator`; output is a guide video. `ltx2_3_runexx_motion_transfer_dwpose.py` is the LTX-side reference for in-workflow DWPose if a future rail demands it. | DWPose model (`yolox_l.onnx` + `dw-ll_ucoco_384.onnx`) is heavy; one source of truth in reigh-worker is simpler than custom_node bring-up. |
632	| Optical flow | Pre-process | reigh-worker calls `FlowAnnotator` + `flow_viz` (`vendor_imports.py:91-98`); writes flow-viz frames as a guide video. | Same rationale as DWPose; no widely-adopted Comfy flow node-pack. |
633	| Uni3C | In-workflow patch with cache outside the IR | `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/patches/uni3c.py` (NEW) splices a Uni3C ControlNet apply-node into a Wan VACE/I2V template; the heavyweight ControlNet checkpoint load is wrapped in a session-scoped Python cache (module-level dict keyed on `EmbeddedSession.id` and ckpt path), populated once per worker process and cleared by the existing memory-cleanup hook at `source/task_handlers/queue/memory_cleanup.py:41-51`. | `VibeWorkflow` is graph metadata only — there's no IR slot for "cached weights." The cache must live in the runtime layer (analogous to WGP's `orchestrator._cached_uni3c_controlnet` at `model_ops.py:225,246-269`). The patch is graph-topological per `controlnet.py:45-96`. |
634	
635	**Why the cache lives outside the IR.** `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:35-42` defines `RunResult` and the `EmbeddedSession` API; there is no public hook for "preserve this loaded weight tensor across runs in the same session." VibeComfy already uses a session-warm pattern (`runtime_surface.md:64-105`) and the embedded HiddenSwitch context owns model lifecycle. The Uni3C migration plan: the Uni3C patch's `apply` records that Uni3C is required, and the reigh-worker adapter installs a `before_run` hook on the `EmbeddedSession` that calls `load_uni3c_controlnet(...)` (existing function via `vendor_imports.py:125-132`) once per session and stashes the result on a module-level dict. The Comfy node `WanVideoUni3CController` (or whatever the underlying custom node is named in `ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper`) reads from that dict via a small custom-node shim. **Open question Q13** below covers the custom-node shim ownership.
636	
637	**IR sketch — Wan I2V + Uni3C control rail.** Starting from `ready_templates/video/wanvideo_wrapper_21_14b_i2v.py` (already loads Wan I2V via `WanVideoModelLoader` at line 85), the Uni3C patch performs:
638	
639	```text
640	applies_to(wf):
641	    return any(n.class_type == "WanVideoModelLoader" for n in wf.nodes.values()) \
642	       and any(n.class_type == "WanVideoSampler" for n in wf.nodes.values())
643	
644	apply(wf, *, guide_video_path, strength=1.0, ckpt_dir):
645	    # 1. Locate sampler and its `image_embeds` source (the WanVideoVACEEncode or WanVideoImageToVideoEncode).
646	    sampler_id = next(nid for nid, n in wf.nodes.items() if n.class_type == "WanVideoSampler")
647	    embeds_edge = next(e for e in wf.edges
648	                       if e.to_node == sampler_id and e.to_input == "image_embeds")
649	    # 2. Add the guide-video loader and the Uni3C controller node (custom node from ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper).
650	    guide = wf.add_node("VHS_LoadVideo", widget_0=guide_video_path)
651	    uni3c = wf.add_node("WanVideoUni3CController",
652	                        widget_0=ckpt_dir, widget_1=strength)
653	    # 3. Splice: the existing embeds source still feeds the sampler, but the sampler's
654	    #    `controlnet` (or `extra_model_inputs`) handle now consumes Uni3C output.
655	    wf.connect(f"{guide.id}.0", f"{uni3c.id}.images")
656	    wf.connect(f"{uni3c.id}.0", f"{sampler_id}.controlnet")
657	    # 4. Mark cache requirement so the runtime adapter pre-loads the ckpt.
658	    wf.metadata.setdefault("uni3c_ckpt_dir", ckpt_dir)
659	    return wf.finalize_metadata()
660	```
661	
662	The exact input slot name (`controlnet` vs `extra_model_inputs`) depends on the WanVideoSampler node schema in the installed `ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper` revision; that is a Sprint 4 schema check (`vibecomfy.cli inspect ready_templates/video/wanvideo_wrapper_21_14b_i2v` per `vibecomfy/docs/adding_templates_models.md:137-143`).

664	### Travel continuity and travel_stitch
665	
666	Wan2GP travel mechanics are anchored in three files:
667	
668	- `_handle_travel_segment_via_queue_impl` at `reigh-worker/source/task_handlers/tasks/task_registry.py:1298-1357` resolves segment context, generation inputs, image refs, and structure guidance, then submits a child `GenerationTask` via `task_queue.submit_task(...)` (`task_registry.py:1337-1344`) using the DB task id as the queue task id.
669	- `_apply_video_source_continuation` at `task_registry.py:1106-1144` writes `video_source` (path of the predecessor segment's tail) into `generation_params` and removes `image_start`. This handles both SVI and `prefix_video_source` strategies.
670	- `_apply_uni3c_config` at `task_registry.py:1326-1328` (called next) bolts on Uni3C parameters when `travel_guidance_config.kind in {"vace", "uni3c"}` (`travel/orchestrator.py:797`) or when structure guidance is `is_uni3c` (`travel/orchestrator.py:842-844`).
671	
672	**Pinned templates.**
673	
674	- Wan-family travel segment (`_derive_model_family(model_name) == "wan"` at `travel/orchestrator.py:38-49`): `ready_templates/video/wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py`. Its `WanVideoVACEStartToEndFrame` node at `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:470-475,498-504` is the seed-frame seam; `start_image` and `end_image` SetNodes at `wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:236-279` are where the per-segment first/last frames bind.
675	- LTX-family travel segment: `ready_templates/video/ltx2_3_runexx_first_last_frame.py`. Its widgetised first/last frame inputs are the direct LTX equivalent.
676	
677	**continue_video_path / video_source flow.** When `_apply_video_source_continuation` writes `generation_params["video_source"] = <path>` (`task_registry.py:1119-1120`), the VibeComfy adapter translates that to a template patch:
678	
679	```text
680	On the chosen Wan VACE template:
681	  1. Locate the VHS_LoadVideo node id that currently feeds `vhs_loadvideo_2` →
682	     ImageResizeKJv2 → SetNode("InputVideo") chain (wanvideo_wrapper_13b_vace.py:204-209).
683	  2. Set node.widgets["video"] = video_source_path (the predecessor's tail).
684	  3. wf.finalize_metadata() so `register_input("video_source", ...)` is emitted.
685	On the LTX runexx_first_last_frame template:
686	  1. Set the LoadImage node for `start_image` to the predecessor's last extracted frame
687	     (reigh-worker already extracts via `_resolve_image_references` at task_registry.py:1317).
688	  2. Set the LoadImage for `end_image` to the next segment's target frame.
689	```
690	
691	**SVI vs prefix continuation.** Both strategies share the `video_source` field in WGP (`task_registry.py:1141-1147`). In VibeComfy, both translate to the same `VHS_LoadVideo.video` widget edit; the SVI-specific latent-tail upload at `task_registry.py:1356` (`_upload_svi_latent_tail_if_available`) stays in reigh-worker and is unaffected by backend choice.
692	
693	**travel_stitch.** This is **NATIVE (no template)** in 1A — `source/task_handlers/travel/stitch.py:804` does ffmpeg-based concatenation with optional VLM enhancement. Backend selection is irrelevant. The only Comfy-side concern is that segment outputs come from `RunResult.outputs[0]` and match the path shape that stitch expects (`current_stitched_video_path` at `stitch.py:804`); the observability shim in Section 7 already normalizes `RunResult.outputs` to existing output-path shapes.
694	
695	### Qwen prompt expander placement
696	
697	Decision: **pre-process before workflow build** in reigh-worker. Rationale:
698	
699	- The expander rewrites prompt text and changes nothing about graph topology, so by the rule at `vibecomfy/docs/authoring.md:54` it is not a template / patch concern.

706	## 4. Sprint-by-sprint migration plan
707	
708	Each sprint is scoped to one or two weeks. The sequence is designed to retire risk incrementally: discovery freeze and shadow baselines first, then memory-profile parity, adapter wiring, dual-run comparison, cohort canary, cutover, and only then Wan2GP removal.
709	
710	Critical path:
711	
712	```text
713	Sprint 0 -> Sprint 1 -> Sprint 2 -> Sprint 3 -> Sprints 4 and 5 in parallel -> Sprint 6 -> Sprint 7 -> Sprint 8
714	```

730	## 5. Per-task-type cutover order
731	
732	Cutover is by runtime task type, not by friendly display name. The canary selector reads a server-side `backend_for_task_type` map at task claim time, so rollback can flip a cohort or an individual task type back to WGP without changing the queue schema.
733	
734	| Cohort | Risk level | Task types | Template readiness (per 1A) | Rationale | Entry gate | Promotion gate | Rollback selector |
735	| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
736	| Cohort A | Lowest: image-only and comparatively deterministic | `z_image_turbo`, `z_image_turbo_i2i`, `qwen_image`, `qwen_image_2512`, `flux`, `wan_2_2_t2i` | NATIVE: `z_image_turbo`, `qwen_image_2512`. ADAPT rows must have their patches landed and tested before promotion (not just queue-seam wiring). | 48-hour canary hold with no p95 latency regression beyond threshold, no error-class spike, and output dimensions/format matching baselines. | Set each Cohort A key in `backend_for_task_type` back to `wgp`. |

741	
742	The selector contract is:
743	
744	```text
745	task claim
746	  -> read backend_for_task_type[task_type]
747	  -> default to process --backend / REIGH_BACKEND
748	  -> dispatch through the selected backend
749	```
750	
751	For Cohort E, the parent task's backend selection is authoritative for child generation unless a child route is explicitly blocked. That prevents mixed WGP/Comfy orchestration where the parent reports Comfy telemetry while the child is silently submitted to WGP.
752	
753	## 6. Rollback plan
754	
755	Rollback must stay operational until Sprint 8 starts. Before then, every Comfy canary is reversible by selection, not by rebuilding an image.
756	
757	### Rollback Controls
758	
759	| Control | Scope | Required behavior |
760	| --- | --- | --- |
761	| `--backend wgp|comfy` | Worker process | Process-level default set by the worker startup command. This should map to `REIGH_BACKEND={wgp|comfy}` internally. |
762	| `REIGH_BACKEND={wgp|comfy}` | Worker process / local dev | Environment default used by scripts, live tests, and fallback startup paths. |
763	| `backend_for_task_type` | Server-side task-type override | Read at task claim time. A present task-type value overrides the process default; an absent value falls back to `--backend` / `REIGH_BACKEND`. |
764	| Cohort rollback | Server-side selector update | Flip one cohort or individual task type back to `wgp` without changing task payloads, queue rows, or Supabase schema. |
765	| Worker image rollback | Orchestrator deployment | Until Sprint 8, WGP and VibeComfy both remain in the worker image, so the orchestrator can launch WGP-default workers immediately. |
766	
767	The adapter scope for rollback is the same as the adapter scope for migration:
768	
769	- Direct-queue seam: `_handle_direct_queue_task` -> `db_task_to_generation_task` -> backend queue submission.
770	- Nested-handler seam: handlers receiving `context["task_queue"]` and enqueueing child generation tasks.
771	
772	If either seam cannot honor `REIGH_BACKEND` and `backend_for_task_type`, the relevant cohort remains WGP-only.
773	
774	### Trigger Conditions
775	
776	Rollback triggers should be defined from Sprint 0 baselines and Sprint 3 dual-run thresholds:
777	
778	| Trigger | Action |
779	| --- | --- |
780	| p95 latency exceeds baseline by the agreed N% threshold for a cohort | Flip that cohort's `backend_for_task_type` entries back to `wgp`; keep collecting Comfy shadow data if possible. |
781	| Error-class spike for OOM, model-load, schema-validation, prompt-queue, timeout, or missing-output | Roll back affected task types first; roll back the full cohort if error classes cross task-family boundaries. |
782	| Output-divergence rate exceeds the agreed threshold | Stop promotion for the cohort; restore WGP for divergent task types; add examples to the dual-run corpus. |
783	| VRAM or OOM count regresses against profile 1 or profile 3 baselines | Roll back the affected memory profile / task family and retune `MemoryProfile.to_session_overrides()`. |
784	| Parent/child backend mismatch in orchestrated tasks | Roll back Cohort E immediately and block further promotion until child-task seam tests pass. |
785	| Worker startup or health-check regression after orchestrator flag changes | Launch workers with `REIGH_BACKEND=wgp` and revert the startup-template change that passed the Comfy default. |
786	
787	`reigh-worker-orchestrator/gpu_orchestrator/runpod/worker_startup.template.sh` must pass the selected backend/profile through the worker startup command during canary. That change is reversible until Sprint 8 because the dual-stack worker image still contains WGP.
788	
789	## 7. Telemetry and observability
790	
791	Telemetry must let operators compare WGP and VibeComfy runs at the same level of detail during shadow, dual-run, and canary. The goal is not a new observability system; it is a compatibility shim that makes Comfy runs show up in existing heartbeat logs, `system_logs`, and debug-card diagnostics.
792	
793	### Required Labels and Fields
794	
795	| Field | Applies to | Purpose |
796	| --- | --- | --- |
797	| `backend` | All task logs and status updates | Values: `wgp` or `comfy`; required for cohort dashboards and rollback filters. |
798	| `template_id` | Comfy/VibeComfy runs | VibeComfy ready-template id or raw `comfy` workflow route used by the task. |
799	| `memory_profile` | Both backends | Numeric profile 1-5 plus resolved display name; required for prod profile 1 and dev profile 3 baseline comparison. |
800	| `vibecomfy.run_id` | VibeComfy runs | `RunResult.run_id` from `vibecomfy/vibecomfy/runtime/session.py:35-42`; attach to start, completion, and failure logs. |
801	| `comfy.prompt_id` | Comfy prompt submissions | `RunResult.prompt_id`; useful for Comfy history, queue, and prompt failure lookup. |
802	| `metadata_path` | VibeComfy runs | `RunResult.metadata_path`; attach to debug-card context where present. |
803	| `log_path` | VibeComfy runs | `RunResult.log_path`; capture into `source/core/log/debug_card.py` and failure diagnostics. |
804	
805	### Memory and Runtime Metrics
806	
807	The Comfy path must mirror the memory-stat shape currently emitted by WGP output logging in `source/models/wgp/generators/output.py:182-208`. At minimum, each run should log:
808	
809	- Host RAM used/available.
810	- CUDA allocated and reserved VRAM.
811	- Total CUDA VRAM.
812	- Selected backend.
813	- Template id.
814	- Memory profile 1-5.
815	- Embedded vs managed-server execution path.
816	- OOM count and error class when the run fails.
817	
818	### Log Translation
819	
820	| Source | Existing target | Required translation |
821	| --- | --- | --- |
822	| `RunResult.outputs` | Worker completion output path | Normalize to the existing output shape for image, video, raw-Comfy, and orchestrated child tasks. |
823	| `RunResult.run_id` | heartbeat logs and `system_logs` | Emit as `vibecomfy.run_id` consistently across start, success, retry, and failure paths. |
824	| `RunResult.prompt_id` | debug breadcrumbs and Comfy diagnostics | Emit as `comfy.prompt_id`; include in failure and timeout messages. |
825	| `RunResult.log_path` | `source/core/log/debug_card.py` | Add a debug-card link or path entry so support can inspect Comfy/VibeComfy logs. |
826	| VibeComfy validation failures | Worker retry/fail classification | Map to schema-validation or template-routing error class, not generic Python failure. |
827	
828	Dual-run reports and canary dashboards should group metrics by `task_type`, `backend`, `template_id`, `memory_profile`, error class, and worker image version. Without these labels, rollback decisions will rely on raw exception text and task ids, which is too slow for production canary.
829

958	
959	### Assumptions
960	
961	- Queue contracts and Supabase schema remain unchanged.
962	- `reigh-app` UI and API behavior remain unaffected.
963	- VibeComfy is the canonical home for new templates.
964	- The five-tier memory-profile display contract is preserved.
965	- Default profile remains environment-specific unless Q10 decides otherwise: production profile 1 from `worker_startup.template.sh:463`, development profile 3 from `start_worker.bat:14` and `scripts/live_test/{main,smoke}.py:27`.
966	- Both `pyproject.toml` `headless_wgp` entries, at lines 109 and 165, are treated as duplicate WGP registrations and both must be removed in Sprint 8.
967	- `reigh-worker/`, `reigh-worker-orchestrator/`, and `vibecomfy/` are independent Git repos nested in the workspace. Git-aware closure sweeps must use per-repo `git -C` invocations, or use filesystem traversal with `rg`.
968	- WGP and VibeComfy stay coinstalled in the worker image until Sprint 8 starts.
969	
970	### Risks and Mitigations
971	
972	| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
973	| --- | --- | --- |
974	| Missing 1-5 profile tier | P0 blocker; cutover would lose the non-negotiable memory contract. | Sprint 1 `MemoryProfile` overlay, profile 1 and profile 3 baselines, and per-profile smoke tests. |
975	| Embedded ComfyUI cold boot or session churn | Latency regression and failed canary SLOs. | Use a long-lived `EmbeddedSession`; measure cold and warm timings in Sprint 0/Sprint 3. |
976	| Template catalog drift | Task routing silently points at stale or renamed ready templates. | Add `template_routing.py` tests that validate every routed template id exists and compiles. |
977	| Hunyuan template absence | Cohort D cannot reach parity. | Sprint 4 hard gate with VibeComfy maintainer ownership; no Cohort D canary before `ready_templates/video/hunyuan_*`. |
978	| LoRA divergence | Output drift or failed runs for Qwen/edit workflows. | Golden-output LoRA corpus and VibeComfy `LoraLoader` sanitizer patch. |
979	| Pod disk too small during dual-run | Worker startup or model download failures. | Sprint 0 baseline for image size, startup time, model cache size, and RunPod `disk_size_gb`. |
980	| Orchestrated child-task seam missed by adapter | Parent tasks report Comfy while child generation still uses WGP or fails. | Sprint 2 dual-seam wiring; Sprint 6 parent-to-child smokes; Cohort E promotion blocked until both seams pass. |
981	| Existing `source/models/comfy` integration drifts | Two Comfy implementations survive and split output/telemetry behavior. | Sprint 2 retire/refactor: `comfy_handler.py` delegates to VibeComfy, `comfy_utils.py` is removed, tests migrate. |
982	| Orchestrator startup-script Wan2GP coupling missed at cleanup | New worker image still discovers or expects `Headless-Wan2GP`. | Section 8 checklist explicitly names `worker_startup.template.sh` touchpoints and `gpu_orchestrator/runpod/startup_script.py`. |
983	| Residual WGP entrypoints/tests left after directory deletion | Build/test failures or dead CLI surfaces after Sprint 8. | Section 8 explicit per-file list plus mandatory Section 10 per-repo grep sweep. |
984	| Closure sweep run from workspace root silently skips nested repos | False clean result before WGP deletion. | Section 10 requires per-repo `git -C` Option A and filesystem `rg` Option B. |
985	| Hunyuan NEW template under-specified | Cohort D blocked indefinitely if `hunyuan` template authoring stalls without a maintainer-confirmed model family (T2V vs I2V vs both) and node pack. | Section 1A flags `hunyuan` as the sole NEW disposition; Q8 names ownership; basis is HunyuanVideo official ComfyUI workflow. Promote to a tracked sprint deliverable, not a gap entry. |
986	| Wan 2.2 VACE cocktail requires a NEW template not yet authored | `vace_22`, `inpaint_frames`, `join_clips_segment`, and the Wan-family `travel_segment` paths cannot promote until either the kj-wrapper template accepts the 2.2 cocktail (ADAPT path) or a NEW `wanvideo_wrapper_22_vace.py` ships. | Sprint 4 validation gate per Q17; if ADAPT fails, name a NEW owner and timeline before Cohort D promotion. |
987	| Uni3C cache behavior is not part of the VibeComfy public surface | The runtime-layer dict in Section 3A is reigh-worker-private; future VibeComfy refactors of `EmbeddedSession` could break the before-run hook. | Document the hook in `reigh-worker/source/models/comfy/template_routing.py` and add a contract test that asserts `EmbeddedSession.start`/`stop` semantics relevant to the cache. |
988	| Wan2GP LoRA-key tolerance is stricter than ComfyUI native | Stacked user LoRAs that loaded under WGP via `apply_lora_key_tolerance_patch` could still raise under ComfyUI's stricter validators if the sanitizer patch in Section 3A is incomplete. | Sprint 5 corpus must include the lightx2v Wan 2.2 distilled-LoRA family that originally motivated `wgp_patches.py:384-483`; promotion blocked until those LoRAs round-trip clean. |
989	| Custom-node dependencies surface that aren't in `custom_nodes.lock` | Templates such as `wanvideo_wrapper_22_5b_i2v_controlnet` declare `ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper`/`ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite`/`ComfyUI-KJNodes` (`READY_REQUIREMENTS.custom_nodes`); Flux Klein GGUF variant adds `ComfyUI-GGUF`; Hunyuan NEW will likely add another node pack. | Pre-canary, the worker image's custom-node lockfile must enumerate every pack referenced by any template `template_routing.py` can select; CI step lists `READY_REQUIREMENTS.custom_nodes` across selected templates and diffs against the lock. |

235	                    raise
236	        self._comfy = None
237	        self._context = None
238	        self._schema_provider = None
239	        self._schema_warning_emitted = False
240	        self.last_fingerprint = None
241	        await self.start()

244	class ServerSession:
245	    def __init__(self, config: SessionConfig | None = None) -> None:
246	        self.config = config or SessionConfig()
247	        self.last_fingerprint: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None
248	        self.process: asyncio.subprocess.Process | None = None
249	        self.url: str | None = None
250	        self.log_handle: Any | None = None
251	        self._argv = _comfy_server_argv(self.config)
252	        self._schema_provider: Any | None = None
253	        self._schema_warning_emitted = False
254	        self._inflight_run: asyncio.Task[Any] | None = None
255	
256	    def _on_schema_unavailable(self, msg: str) -> None:
257	        if self._schema_warning_emitted:
258	            return
259	        logger.warning("vibecomfy schema gate: %s", msg)
260	        self._schema_warning_emitted = True
261	
262	    async def start(self) -> None:
263	        if self.process is not None and self.process.returncode is None:
264	            return
265	        if self.process is not None:
266	            await self.stop()
267	        self.process, self.url, self.log_handle = await _spawn_comfy_server(self.config)
268	        self._argv = _comfy_server_argv(self.config)
269	
270	    async def run(self, workflow: VibeWorkflow, *, backend: str = "api") -> RunResult:
271	        if self._inflight_run is not None and not self._inflight_run.done():
272	            raise RuntimeError("session already has a run in flight; concurrent run() is not supported in P1")
273	        task = asyncio.current_task()
274	        self._inflight_run = task
275	        try:
276	            return await self._run_untracked(workflow, backend=backend)
277	        finally:
278	            if self._inflight_run is task:
279	                self._inflight_run = None
280	
281	    async def _run_untracked(self, workflow: VibeWorkflow, *, backend: str = "api") -> RunResult:
282	        await self.start()
283	        assert self.url is not None
284	        if self._schema_provider is None:
285	            self._schema_provider = _build_schema_provider(self.url)
286	        api_dict = await _prepare_prompt_async(
287	            workflow,
288	            backend=backend,
289	            schema_provider=self._schema_provider,
290	            on_unavailable=self._on_schema_unavailable,
291	        )
292	        fp = model_fingerprint(api_dict)
293	
294	        await _maybe_flush_for_policy(self, fp)
295	
296	        run_id = f"run-{int(time.time())}"
297	        run_dir = Path("out/runs") / run_id
298	        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
299	        log_path = run_dir / "comfy.log"
300	
301	        client_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
302	        watchdog = await _start_watchdog(server_url=self.url, client_id=client_id, api_dict=api_dict)
303	        stop_reason = "completed"
304	        try:
305	            try:
306	                queued = await ComfyClient(self.url).queue_prompt(api_dict)
307	            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
308	                stop_reason = "timeout"
309	                raise
310	            except Exception as exc:
311	                stop_reason = "exception"
312	                raise RuntimeError(f"Workflow queue failed: {exc}") from exc
313	        finally:
314	            await _finalize_watchdog(watchdog, run_dir=run_dir, reason=stop_reason)
315	        self.last_fingerprint = fp
316	        metadata = _run_metadata(
317	            run_id=run_id,
318	            workflow=workflow,
319	            api_dict=api_dict,
320	            queued=queued,
321	            outputs=[],
322	            runtime="server",
323	        )
324	        metadata_path = run_dir / "metadata.json"
325	        metadata_path.write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
326	        return RunResult(
327	            run_id=run_id,
328	            prompt_id=queued.get("prompt_id") if isinstance(queued, dict) else None,
329	            outputs=[],
330	            metadata_path=str(metadata_path),
331	            log_path=str(log_path),
332	        )
333	
334	    async def flush(self) -> None:
335	        await self.start()
336	        assert self.url is not None
337	        await ComfyClient(self.url).free(unload_models=True, free_memory=True)
338	
339	    async def reconfigure(self, config: SessionConfig) -> bool:
340	        new_argv = _comfy_server_argv(config)
341	        if new_argv == self._argv:
342	            self.config = config
343	            return False
344	        await self.stop()
345	        self.config = config
346	        self._argv = new_argv
347	        await self.start()
348	        return True
349	
350	    async def stop(self, wait_for_inflight: bool = True) -> None:
351	        await _resolve_inflight_before_stop(self, wait_for_inflight)
352	        process = self.process
353	        if process is not None and process.returncode is None:
354	            process.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
355	            try:
356	                await asyncio.wait_for(process.wait(), timeout=15)
357	            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
358	                process.kill()
359	                await process.wait()
360	        if self.log_handle:
361	            self.log_handle.close()
362	        self.process = None
363	        self.url = None
364	        self.log_handle = None
365	
366	    async def reload_for_nodepack_change(self, *, reason: str) -> None:
367	        if self._inflight_run is not None and not self._inflight_run.done():
368	            raise RuntimeError("reload_for_nodepack_change refused: run in flight")
369	        # NOTE: ServerSession external-mode handling (attach to a server VibeComfy didn't spawn) is deferred to MP-5 alongside session-shared multi-stage orchestration. Current production paths route external server URLs through comfy_server(server_url=...) in vibecomfy/runtime/server.py, which already skips spawn/cleanup for external URLs.
370	        await self.stop()
371	        await self.start()
372	        logger.info("reload_for_nodepack_change: %s", reason)
373	
374	
375	async def _resolve_inflight_before_stop(session: Any, wait_for_inflight: bool) -> None:
376	    task = getattr(session, "_inflight_run", None)
377	    if task is None:
378	        return
379	    if task.done():
380	        session._inflight_run = None
381	        return
382	    if not wait_for_inflight:
383	        raise RuntimeError(
384	            "session.stop() called while a run is in flight; pass wait_for_inflight=True or call after run completes"
385	        )
386	    if task is asyncio.current_task():
387	        raise RuntimeError("session.stop() called from the in-flight run; call after run completes")
388	    try:
389	        await task
390	    except BaseException:
391	        session._inflight_run = None
392	        raise
393	    session._inflight_run = None

396	def find_active_session(id: str = "default") -> str | None:
397	    session_dir = Path("out/sessions") / id
398	    pid_path = session_dir / "pid"
399	    url_path = session_dir / "url"
400	    if not pid_path.exists() or not url_path.exists():
401	        _cleanup_session_files(session_dir)
402	        return None
403	    try:
404	        pid = int(pid_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip())
405	        url = url_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
406	    except (OSError, ValueError):
407	        _cleanup_session_files(session_dir)
408	        return None
409	    if not url:
410	        _cleanup_session_files(session_dir)
411	        return None
412	    try:
413	        os.kill(pid, 0)
414	    except ProcessLookupError:
415	        _cleanup_session_files(session_dir)
416	        return None
417	    except PermissionError:
418	        return url
419	    except OSError:
420	        _cleanup_session_files(session_dir)
421	        return None
422	    return url

433	def _partition_comfy_config(values: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
434	    """Split mixed config into SessionConfig kwargs and raw extra Comfy keys.
435	
436	    HiddenSwitch keys are translated first, then typed SessionConfig field
437	    names overwrite translated values when both forms are present.
438	    """
439	    typed_fields = {
440	        "port",
441	        "vram_policy",
442	        "cache_policy",
443	        "warm_policy",
444	        "reserve_vram_gb",
445	        "disable_smart_memory",
446	        "auto_flush_vram_threshold_gb",
447	    }
448	    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
449	    extra: dict[str, Any] = {}
450	
451	    for key, value in values.items():
452	        if key in typed_fields:
453	            continue
454	        if key == "reserve_vram":
455	            kwargs["reserve_vram_gb"] = value
456	        elif key in {"highvram", "lowvram", "normalvram"}:
457	            if value:
458	                kwargs["vram_policy"] = key.removesuffix("vram")
459	        elif key == "cache_none":
460	            if value:
461	                kwargs["cache_policy"] = "none"
462	        elif key == "cache_classic":
463	            if value:
464	                kwargs["cache_policy"] = "classic"
465	        elif key == "cache_lru":
466	            if value:
467	                kwargs["cache_policy"] = f"lru:{value}"
468	        else:
469	            extra[key] = value
470	
471	    for key, value in values.items():
472	        if key in typed_fields:
473	            kwargs[key] = value
474	
475	    return kwargs, extra

482	def _build_schema_provider(server_url: str | None) -> Any | None:
483	    if _schema_validate_disabled():

489	
490	async def _warm_schema_provider(
491	    provider: Any | None,
492	    *,
493	    on_unavailable,
494	    cache_only: bool = False,
495	) -> Any | None:
496	    if provider is None:
497	        return None
498	    try:
499	        if getattr(provider, "_object_info", None) is not None:
500	            return provider
501	        if cache_only:
502	            from vibecomfy.schema.cache import load_object_info_cache
503	
504	            cached = load_object_info_cache(provider.cache_path)
505	            if cached is None:
506	                on_unavailable(f"object_info cache unavailable at {provider.cache_path}; using structural validation only")
507	                return None
508	            provider._object_info = cached
509	            return provider
510	
511	        provider._object_info = await provider.object_info_async()
512	        return provider
513	    except (OSError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError) as exc:
514	        on_unavailable(f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}; using structural validation only")
515	        return None

518	def _prepare_prompt(
519	    workflow: VibeWorkflow,
520	    *,
521	    backend: str,
522	    schema_provider: Any | None = None,
523	) -> dict[str, Any]:
524	    # Schema validation: cache-hit on every submit after the first per-runtime; first-fetch latency acceptable.
525	    report = workflow.validate(schema_provider=schema_provider)
526	    if not report.ok:
527	        messages = "; ".join(issue.message for issue in report.issues)
528	        raise ValueError(f"Workflow validation failed: {messages}")
529	
530	    try:
531	        return workflow.compile(backend=backend)
532	    except ValueError as exc:
533	        raise ValueError(f"Workflow build failed: {exc}") from exc
534	    except RuntimeError as exc:
535	        raise RuntimeError(f"Workflow build failed: {exc}") from exc
536	    except Exception as exc:
537	        raise RuntimeError(f"Workflow build failed: {exc}") from exc
